meaning:
ὁρκίζω
(ὅρκος), [in LXX: Gen.24:37, al. (שָׁבַע hi.) ;]
1. to make one swear (Xen., Polyb., a1.).
2. to adjure: with dupl. accusative, Mrk.5:7, Act.19:13 (cf. ἐν-, ἐξ-ορκίζω).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”
